name: cluster_pod_cpu_usage_anomaly
title: Total pod CPU demand is unusual
description: Total CPU used by all pods (sum over pods of each pod's mean k8s_pod_cpu_usage in the bucket) is outside its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band, above or below, in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets. Unit: CPU cores. Whole cluster; add a WHERE clause on k8s_cluster or k8s_namespace_name inside the subquery after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity). Uses a histogram inside a subquery; keep only after a live _search returns one row per bucket.

anomaly_config.custom_sql: SELECT time_bucket, SUM(v) AS cpu_cores FROM (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5m') AS time_bucket, __hash__, AVG(value) AS v FROM "k8s_pod_cpu_usage" GROUP BY time_bucket, __hash__) GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket
